search_results.title: E-commerce platforms report strong start to festive sales, led by smaller towns
search_results.description: E-commerce platforms in India reported robust growth in the opening days of their festive sales, with significant demand emerging from Tier 3 and smaller towns. Amazon witnessed over 100% year-on-year growth in product orders within the first 12 hours of its sale, while Flipkart recorded 6.3 million concurrent users in a minute and saw 60% of demand from non-metro users. Meesho experienced a 75% rise in orders and a 60% increase in transacting customers year-on-year on the first day. Beauty products were top sellers across platforms, with Amazon reporting one in four products sold in the first 12 hours as beauty items. Additionally, sales of premium smartphones, large TVs, and tablets saw significant year-on-year growth across platforms. Payment via EMI also surged, with one in two Amazon buyers opting for it. Quick commerce services such as Amazon Now and Flipkart Minutes saw strong adoption, with rapid delivery and substantial rises in orders and new customers. Markets beyond metros also played a key role in seller growth, particularly on Meesho, where Tier 4-plus vendor participation doubled. None of the platforms disclosed gross merchandise value for the sales.
